title: Copilot Studio Engineer
description: About the position The mission of the team is to accelerate the identification, analysis and execution of intelligent automation activities, while delivering efficiency, consistency and quality improvements to our wholesale banking operations worldwide. As an Intelligent Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying automation & AI solutions to drive operational excellence across ING’s global wholesale banking operations. You will collaborate closely with business analysts, stakeholders, and other engineers to deliver scalable, high-quality automation & AI solutions. Responsibilities: Design and develop intelligent automation solutions by primarily using Python. Based on personal interest and/or business need, other related automation and AI technologies might also be used in solution delivery, such as ABBYY Vantage and MS PowerPlatform. (Power Automate, PowerApps, PowerBI) Design and develop AI solutions by primarily using MS Copilot and MS Copilot Studio. Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. Collaborate with tech leads to align on technical solution design and QA testing. Ensure automation solutions are efficiently and effectively implemented by proactively reviewing and recommending changes to overall operating model. Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including solution design documents and user guidelines. Promote best practices in automation development, code quality, and QA testing. Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI, automation, and related technologies. Design integrations between automation solutions and enterprise platforms using APIs and related technologies. Coach and guide citizen developers, conduct solution reviews, and support automation adoption across business communities. Requirements and skills: 3+ years of hands-on experience in Python-based development, preferably in intelligent automation and/or AI workflow projects. Proven understanding on AI technologies and solution delivery using -MS Copilot and MS Copilot Studio Fluent in English (Nice-to-have) Experience with intelligent document processing (IDP) and/or natural language processing (NLP) and/or machine learning (ML) and/or SQL. Familiarity with process automation & AI delivery frameworks. Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders and in cross-functional teams. Wage (gross) 2346 EUR/month *By legal requirement we are providing the information about the basic wage component (minimum salary) for the advertised position. Based on your experience/profile, the final financial conditions will be the subject to discuss and negotiate at the personal interview, however, not less than above mentioned minimum salary component. We offer you a bunch of great benefits Friendly working environment You build your own working day - flexible working hours and work from home Daily working time: 7hrs 45min instead of standard 8hrs Daily refreshments - coffee, fruits, drinks Fully equipped gym accessible 24 hours / 7 days per week Game room with unlimited access Modern designed coffee corner and terrace with the grill spot WellbeING Sick leave compensation: up to 80% of the monthly salary Life insurance contribution: up to 22,14 EUR/per month 3rd pillar contribution: up to 3% from your monthly salary 24/7 external mental health support Learning opportunities: internal and external learning programs Regular teambuildings, social events and communities YOU/family/friends time Extra 3 PERSONAL days per year Extra vacation days: up to 10 extra days/per year We welcome your ING-positive friends: referrals starting from 1000 EUR 150€ for childbirth/adoption bonus, wedding day and registered partnership contributions, work anniversary award Our premises are open 24/7 and you can even bring your friends or family along (up to 2 friends to the gym and game room) Extra perks Yearly bonus based on your performance and company’s results Cafeteria points: 50€/month (600€/year) - choose when and how to spend them Home office contribution: 20 EUR/per month Discounts from our and your favourite stores: up to 30% Warm welcome package for your fresh start Pet friendly office
